title.narrative: Assan Aluminyum San. ve Tic. A.S

description.narrative: Assan Aluminyum San. ve Tic. A.S. (Assan or the Company), established in 1988, is the largest manufacturer of aluminum flat-rolled products in Türkiye. The Company has launched a multi-year investment program with an estimated cost of US$130 million over a period of 2022-2024. The program, delayed due to the spillover effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, will modernize Assans operations, reduce carbon footprint, and expand processing capacity for flat rolled aluminum products and scrap by 60,000 tons per annum. It will also address the changing demand profile in its target markets post pandemic and eliminate imports of semifinished products. IFC will be partially advising and financing this program with a senior loan in form of an A Loan up to US$90 million that potentially will be structured as a Green Loan (the IFC Loan).

Through the capacity expansion (processing capacity increase for ingots and scrap by 60,000 tons per annum) and increase in exports, the Project will support higher value-addition and employment creation for the Turkish economy. Furthermore, by implementing measures to improve production efficiency, the success of the Project will incentivize Assans competitors and other players in the market to upgrade the efficiency of their operations and improve production capacity.
